newsitem.title: JAPAN: N.Korea radio cancels live coverage of Kim event.
newsitem.headline: N.Korea radio cancels live coverage of Kim event.

text.p: North Korea's state-run radio stations on Sunday cancelled plans to broadcast live one of the events to mark the 55th birthday of Pyongyang leader Kim Jong-il.

Tokyo-based Radiopress news services, which monitors North Korean broadcasts, said Radio Pyongyang and Korean Central Radio failed to air live coverage of a gymnastics display that was due to begin at 0700 GMT.
The two radio stations had earlier announced they would broadcast live the gymnastics event, Radiopress said.
Instead, the state-run radio stations ran different programmes without giving any explanations, Radiopress said.
It was not clear why the live coverage was cancelled.
